basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm a 32-year-old shoe enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I have a deep passion for unique footwear, especially Dr. Martens. When I'm not hunting for rare shoe finds, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to keep flexible hours. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and late at night. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring local music scenes and art galleries.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts, which I pursued due to my love for creativity and design. Over the years, I've developed a keen eye for fashion and footwear, often sharing my insights and reviews on various forums. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught expertise, especially in the realm of digital design and online marketplaces.
